nodes.name: theo:main_prime: An $\mathcal{F}_n$ -minimal $\Gamma$ -flow for all $n \in \mathbb{N}$
nodes.statement:
If $(\mathcal{F}_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ is a sequence of unbounded families of finite subsets of $\Gamma$, then there exists a free $\Gamma$-flow 
        that is $\mathcal{F}_n$-minimal for all $n \in \mathbb{N}$.

nodes.name: theo:generic: $\mathcal{F}$ -minimal subflows are generic
nodes.statement:
Let $X$ be an amply syndetic\xspace $\Gamma$-space and let $Y$ be a Polish $\Gamma$-flow. For each 
        unbounded family $\mathcal{F}$ of finite subsets of $\Gamma$, the set \[\{Z \in \mathsf{Sub}_X(Y) \,:\, \text{$Z$ is $\mathcal{F}$-minimal}\}\] is dense and $G_\delta$ in $\mathsf{Sub}_X(Y)$.

nodes.name: theo:rich, theo:example: / An $\Gamma$ -space namely $\mathsf{Free}(\mathsf{Sep}(s))$
nodes.statement:
There exists a nonempty, free, zero-dimensional 
        amply syndetic\xspace $\Gamma$-space.

For any $s \in \mathbb{N}^+$, $\mathsf{Free}(\mathsf{Sep}(s))$ is an amply syndetic\xspace $\Gamma$-space.

nodes.name: lemma:key: Maps to $\mathsf{Sep}(s)$ making open sets $F$ -syndetic
nodes.statement:
For every $s \in \mathbb{N}^+$ and a finite tuple $U_1$, \ldots, $U_k \subseteq ((s+1)^\Gamma)^{\mathbb{N}}$ of nonempty open sets, there is $n = n(U_1,\ldots, U_k) \in \mathbb{N}$ such that for all finite $F \subset \Gamma$ with $|F| \geqslant n$, the following holds:
        
        \smallskip
        
        \noindent Every free zero-dimensional Polish $\Gamma$-space $X$ 
        such that $\mathsf{asi}_{\mathsf{c}}(X) \leqslant s$ admits a continuous $\Gamma$-equivariant map $\pi \colon X \to \mathsf{Sep}(s)$ such that the sets $\pi^{-1}(U_1)$, \ldots, $\pi^{-1}(U_k)$ are $F$-syndetic.

nodes.name: lemma:from_separation_to_map: Maps to $\mathsf{Sep}(s)$ with $\Phi$ -spaced constraints
nodes.statement:
For every $s \in \mathbb{N}^+$ and a finite tuple $U_1$, \ldots, $U_k \subseteq ((s+1)^\Gamma)^{\mathbb{N}}$ of nonempty open sets, there is a finite set $\Phi = \Phi(U_1, \ldots, U_k) \subset \Gamma$ with the following property:

       \smallskip
       
       \noindent Suppose $X$ is a free zero-dimensional Polish $\Gamma$-space such that $\mathsf{asi}_{\mathsf{c}}(X) \leqslant s$, and let $A_1$, \ldots, $A_k \subseteq X$ be disjoint clopen sets whose union $A \coloneqq A_1 \sqcup \ldots \sqcup A_k$ is $\Phi$-spaced. Then there exists a continuous $\Gamma$-equivariant map $\pi \colon X \to \mathsf{Sep}(s)$ such that $\pi(x) \in U_i$
        for all $1 \leqslant i \leqslant k$ and $x \in A_i$.

nodes.name: lemma:sparse_syndetic: $F$ -syndetic $\Phi$ -spaced sets
nodes.statement:
For any $s$, $k \in \mathbb{N}^+$ and a finite set $\Phi \subset \Gamma$, there is $n = n(s,k, \Phi) \in \mathbb{N}$ such that for all finite $F \subset \Gamma$ with $|F| \geqslant n$, the following holds:

        \smallskip
        
        \noindent For every free zero-dimensional Polish $\Gamma$-space $X$ such that $\mathsf{asi}_{\mathsf{c}}(X) \leqslant s$, there exist disjoint $F$-syndetic clopen subsets $A_1$, \ldots, $A_k \subseteq X$ whose union 
        
          
         
          
          $A \coloneqq A_1 \sqcup \ldots \sqcup A_k$ is $\Phi$-spaced.
